name: Company Branding
tagline: Capture your house style once — voice, grammar calls, banned words, product terminology — then every draft follows it.
who: Companies whose copy sounds different in every asset because the style rules live in someone's head.
how: Drop your existing brand docs and 10–20 pieces of on-brand content into the workspace. The agent infers your style guide — voice qualities with on-brand/off-brand pairs, grammar hard rules, the banned-words table with replacements, product terminology — marking every inferred rule for you to confirm as a suggestion in the doc. The two decisions worth making deliberately (em dashes, Oxford comma) come to you as a question. The finished guide lives on the agent's computer, and from then on a pre-delivery checklist runs silently on everything it writes for you.
